summary: Public Policy Holding Company filed an 8-K on the entry into a $105.0 million senior secured credit agreement with Bank of America as administrative agent, comprising a $65.0 million term loan and a $40.0 million revolver, maturing November 2, 2031, priced at SOFR plus 185-230 bps. Proceeds refinance existing debt, fund permitted acquisitions including Reevemark, and cover working capital; obligations are subsidiary-guaranteed and secured by substantially all personal property. Best-efforts syndication to $150 million is targeted for January 2027, plus a $50 million uncommitted accordion. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
